item.title: Allen’s record ton powers New Zealand into T20 World Cup final
item.description: KOLKATA (AFP): New Zealand’s Finn Allen blasted the fastest century in T20 World Cup history in Kolkata on Wednesday as his side hammered South Africa by nine wickets to reach the final. item.title: China raises defense budget by 7 percent for 2026: official report
item.description: BEIJING (AFP) : China said on Thursday its defense budget, the world’s second largest after the United States, will increase by seven percent in 2026, in line with expectations but slightly below last year’s. Beijing plans to spend 1.9096 trillion yuan ($276.8 billion) on defense — around three times less than the US military budget. […]
